science: Root read the actual final apparatus, source, oracle, independent counting-generator reference, grader, validator, AUTHOR, reports and peer. Both models retain exact stationary state kinetics. Reversible regeneration work counts elementary chemical-route currents; the completed source uses aggregate Markov entropy production and loses chemical cycles between routes. The log-sum identity proves a nonnegative missing work rate.
public_input_review: Distinct fuel/product stoichiometry, fixed chemical potentials, rates and energy signs, stationary preparation and operational reversible regeneration work are specified. No correction formula or solver mandate. Unrestricted implementation instruction and unfinished fit; private answers and hints excluded from image.
calibration_review: 288 records at 18 nonzero equal-affinity settings with two active routes and genuinely distinct barriers. Source and physical model agree for every rate scale. Positive linear scale dependence proves global identifiability. Fixed sigma .003 is independent of unknown parameter and response.
grading_review: All 256 oracle draws pass; all shortcuts fail three diagnostic groups and pass the anchor. Maximum oracle error .00018344, minimum shortcut diagnostic error .17707, ordinary prediction gate .04. Full public-domain 1024 corners and 128 independent characteristic-generator cases pass consistency checks; reference error at most 1.59e-11. Local oracle 7/7 and shortcut 4+3.
classification_caveat: Using aggregate entropy production for reservoir regeneration is a physical measurement/model error. Recognizing route-specific chemical work but making rate, sign, normalization or implementation mistakes must be classified separately.
overlap: Real thematic overlap with Floquet channel-resolved calorimetry is acknowledged; this is not claimed to be an unrelated principle.
